options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: intervals
options.description: List of interval definitions for the job policy schedule. Each interval specifies a time window and its impact level.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: policy_id
options.description: The unique identifier of the job policy. Can be used to identify the policy for get, modify, or delete operations.

options.name: policy_name
options.description: The name of the job policy. Required when I(state) is C(present).

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the job policy. C(present) - The policy should exist on the system. C(absent) - The policy should not exist on the system.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
